description: Gluetun is a multi-protocol VPN tunnel engine

first_launch.cmd: iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o tun0 -j MASQUERADE && iptables -A FORWARD -i eth0 -o tun0 -m state --state RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT && iptables -A FORWARD -i tun0 -o eth0 -j ACCEPT && iptables -A FORWARD -i eth0 -o tun0 -s 172.20.0.0/16 -d 0.0.0.0/0 -j ACCEPT
